chat.title: Murairidzi WeMari
chat.greeting: Mhoro Grace! Ndingakubatsira sei nemari yako nhasi?

grow.title: Kukura kwemari yangu
grow.riskText: Kukura kwemari kunogara kune njodzi. Usatsvagise mari iyo usingakwanisi kuirasikirwa.

cards.title: Mabhuku ekuchengeta
cards.text: Chengeta mari diki yezvinhu zvisazivikanwa kuti usadzorese.

cards.title: Akaunti yekuchengetedza
cards.text: Mari muakaunti yekuchengetedza yakachengeteka kupfuura mari kumba uye inogona kuwana faida.

cards.title: Faida inowedzera
cards.text: Faida inowana faida. Kuchengetedza zvishoma nguva yekutanga kunokura kupfuura kuchengetedza zvakawanda gare gare.

messages.text: Mhoro Grace! Hupfu hwemhunga hwakachipa neR15 kuShoprite nhasi.
Zvagadzirwa. R15 yakawedzerwa ku-Frosty. Uri paR1,215 kubva R6,000.
